name: Maachah
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Asa takes the sodomites out of the land, removes the idols his fathers made, and even removes his own mother Maachah from being queen because she made an idol in a grove, which he destroys and burns at the brook Kidron.

note.label: 1 Kings 15: Abijam, Asa, Nadab, and Baasha

points: Rehoboam takes Mahalath and Abihail as wives who bear him children, then takes Maachah the daughter of Absalom, whom he loves above all his wives and concubines.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 11: Rehoboam Strengthens Judah and the Levites Return

points: He makes Abijah the son of Maachah chief and ruler among his brethren, intending to make him king, and he deals wisely by dispersing his children through the countries of Judah and Benjamin with abundant provision.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 11: Rehoboam Strengthens Judah and the Levites Return

points: Asa removes Maachah his mother from being queen because she made an idol in a grove; he cuts it down, stamps it, and burns it at the brook Kidron.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 15: The Covenant to Seek the Most High
